positions.name: MigrationDecisionStatus
positions.frame: Is the PostgreSQL-to-QuantumDB migration being enacted as a settled, ratified decision or as a proposal still open for discussion?
positions.why: src-1's present-continuous 'We're switching' and src-3's bolded header-plus-arrow notation both perform the migration as an already-decided, operational fact rather than a proposal — the relational reads mark both authority-ranking (decisive collective act, top-down classification) and conviction marks both decision-grade. The pair spans speaker (Dave Quantum, spoken) and scribe (Xena ExpertGH, summary), so the group holds the same directional stance — settled fact, not open question — across two different renderings of the same act.

positions.name: MigrationJustification
positions.frame: What benefits are being claimed to justify the switch away from PostgreSQL?
positions.why: src-2's 'lower licensing cost' and 10x performance claim, and src-4's restatement of the same 10x figure, both frame the switch through a cost/benefit calculus — the relational reads mark both market-pricing and rational-persuasion, and both sit at claim-level conviction (asserted, unhedged, but not independently ratified the way the decision segments are). The group reads the justification thread separately from the decision thread: the benefits are argued, not merely announced.
